title: FlowIntel's chatbot component used a single shared MCP (Model Context Protocol) session and process-wide environment…
description: FlowIntel's chatbot component prior to version 4.1.0 used a single shared Model Context Protocol (MCP) session and a process-wide environment variable to handle per-user API credentials. This design flaw allowed credentials from one user to be accessible or applied to another user's chatbot tool invocation, leading to potential unauthorized data access. The vulnerability could cause lower-privilege users to access higher-privilege user data and allow invalidated sessions to continue operating under cached credentials.
